errors.text_span: reicht von -112.219 Mrd. Euro bis 200.000 Mrd. Euro
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the y-axis ranges from -112.219 Mrd. Euro. The chart image shows the y-axis range is from -150.000 to 200.000.

errors.text_span: während eine blaue Linie den Zufluss und eine violette Linie den Abfluss darstellt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns the data series to the lines. According to the legend, the blue line represents 'Abfluss' (outflow) and the purple line represents 'Zufluss' (inflow), the opposite of what is stated.
The description refers to the green bars in the singular ('Eine grüne Säule'), when there are multiple green bars, one for each year.

errors.text_span: und zeigt eine allgemeine abnehmende Tendenz
errors.evidence: The description provides an interpretation of a trend for the green bars ('a general decreasing tendency'), which is not explicitly stated in the chart and is an oversimplification of the volatile data.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linien für den Zufluss beginnt bei 51.646 Mrd. Euro im Jahr 2005
errors.evidence: The description states the blue line starts at 51.646 Mrd. Euro in 2005, but the chart shows the value is approximately 110.000 Mrd. Euro. The stated value appears to be a hallucination.

errors.text_span: fällt auf 27.499 Mrd. Euro im Jahr 2020 ab
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the value of the green bar in 2020 (27.499) to the blue line. The blue line's value in 2020 is approximately 125.000.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bei -64.546 Mrd. Euro im Jahr 2024 weiter sinkt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the value of the green bar in 2024 (-64.546) to the blue line. The blue line's value in 2024 is positive, approximately 90.000.

errors.text_span: Die violette Linie für den Abfluss beginnt bei 7.492 Mrd. Euro im Jahr 2005
errors.evidence: The description states the purple line begins at 7.492 Mrd. Euro in 2005. The actual value in the chart is approximately 40.000. The value 7.492 does not correspond to this data point.
The description incorrectly attributes the value of the green bar from 2021 (-81.484) to the purple line in 2022. The purple line's value in 2022 is approximately 45.000.

errors.text_span: bevor sie im Jahr 2024 wieder auf -112.219 Mrd. Euro sinkt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the value of the green bar from 2022 (-112.219) to the purple line in 2024. The purple line's value in 2024 is positive, approximately 30.000.
